verdict.rationale: Appwrite offers an official MCP server enabling LLMs to interact with its API/docs and an 'agents' framing for SDK-accurate calls, plus llms.txt and docs.md for AI consumption, indicating real agentic support. However, hands-on probes show the MCP server is credential-gated and requires manual setup (project ID/API key), and there's no evidence of a polished natural-language chat/command interface for end users beyond dev-tool integration.
